info.title: SIJI Research and Agent Graph API

post.description:
Company, product, industry, comparison and continuous tracking use one account quota.

API keys authenticate; quota belongs to the account. A browser may instead
use SIJI's existing session + CSRF protection. ResearchRoute admits and
rate-limits the account before body parsing. Idempotency-Key is optional:
same key retries are replayable for 24h, headerless identical requests for
10min. Research reads SIJI's maintained published intelligence snapshot.

200.description: A bounded JSON or Markdown packet from currently published canonical intelligence.

401.description: A customer API key or authenticated same-origin browser session is required.

403.description: Current plan, key status or scope forbids the operation.

409.description: Idempotency conflict, changed source rights or stale cursor.

422.description: Invalid mode, field selection, identifier or tracking window.

429.description: Account RPM, concurrency, rolling daily usage or enumeration limit.

503.description: Dependency, canonical availability or bounded-work failure. No RU charged.

post.description: Read the current published industry map: companies, products/businesses, industry positions, typed relationships and category summaries.
Resolve names, aliases, tickers, product terms or industry positions to typed SIJI entity references.
Open previously returned entity references and read their public identity and context.
Read recent published changes or track an explicit set of entities with a checkpoint.
Explore relationships around returned entities, change direction, apply filters and reopen exact relationship references.
Find bounded paths between explicit entities or toward selected entity types, with optional waypoints and exclusions.
Read qualified facts for explicit entities or reopen exact fact IDs with status, time, scope and citations.
Read evidence and source references behind facts or relationships, subject to source permissions.
Align selected entities across the requested dimensions while preserving units, periods, evidence state and missing values.
